blocks.html: Despite the torrential rains and strong winds brought about by Typhoon Ullyses, the following Robinsons Malls decided to stay open and operate regular mall hours: Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Magnolia, Forum Robinsons, Robinsons Town Mall Malabon, Robinsons Sta. Rosa, Robinsons Novaliches, Robinsons Place Naga, Robinsons Place Palawan, Robinsons Place Ilocos, Robinsons Place Santiago, Robinsons Place Tuguegarao, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, Robinsons Place Imus, Robinsons Place Gen Trias, Robinsons Town Mall Los Baños, Galleria South, Robinsons Place Lipa, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, and Robinsons Place Pangasinan while Robinsons Place Manila and Robinson Otis will open at 12:00 NN.

On the other hand, for the safety of its customers and employees, the following Robinsons Malls will be closed today: Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Cainta, Robinsons Starmills Pampanga, Robinsons Angeles, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Tagaytay, Robinsons Luisita, and Robinsons Metro East.

For more information, visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or like RobinsonsMalls on Facebook; follow @RobinsonsMallsOfficial on Instagram and @RobinsonsMalls on Twitter; and join their Viber Communities – Robinsons Malls Luzon for Luzon malls and Robinsons Malls VisMin for Visayas and Mindanao malls.
